fields.summary_ko.0: Bank of America raised Walmart (WMT) price target from $126 to $139 (+10.7% upside potential) while maintaining 'Buy' rating; outlook supported by market share expansion and digital marketplace growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Mizuho also raised price target from $125 to $135, estimating Walmart's global GMV at approximately $76.5 billion; 38 of 43 analysts assign 'Buy' or higher rating, with average target of $128.70.
